findings.one_line: The proved band-robust theorem never invokes the score-envelope condition; its coverage and excess follow solely from the external nuisance band, grid approximation, obstacle stability, and multinomial profile bound.
No reproduced step in a proved result consumes the score moment bound; the theorem itself correctly says these score premises cannot yield the unavailable multiplier claim.

The entropy bound is unused by the proved whole-set/leaf construction and is relevant only to the explicitly open multiplier refinement, so it materially overstates the hypotheses of the proved inference result.

cited_checks.note: The supplied verbatim source identifies the lower arm endpoint with E[tilde T|X,A], the upper endpoint with the observed-event contribution plus t_max times dropout probability, and forms CATE lower/upper bounds by subtracting opposite arm endpoints; substituting X=(Z,R) matches the core claim.
